name: Watcher Dodds
summary: At Duskwood's central crossroads, Watcher Dodds keeps watch for the Night Watch. From his roadside outpost, he watches for danger and asks travelers to thin the giant spider population.

sections.title: On the Crossroads Watch
sections.body: Watcher Dodds guards the crossroads for the Night Watch, under Commander Althea Ebonlocke. His post stands where the roads from Darkshire, Raven Hill, and Deadwind Pass meet. Darkshire's palisades shelter the town, but Dodds keeps watch beyond them, amid wolf packs, ravenous ghouls, and oversized spiders. From his roadside camp, he watches for threats and asks passing mercenaries to kill spiders emerging from the undergrowth before they overrun the roads.

faq.answer: Watcher Dodds is a human member of the Night Watch, the militia defending Duskwood from the undead and beasts that plague the region. He is stationed at the central crossroads, outside Darkshire's protection.

faq.q: Where can I find Watcher Dodds?
faq.answer: Watcher Dodds keeps a small roadside camp at the main crossroads in central Duskwood. The roads from Darkshire, Raven Hill, and the southern passes meet there.

faq.q: Why does he want spiders killed?
faq.answer: Giant venomous spiders infest the surrounding woods and prey on wanderers and supply couriers using the road. Watcher Dodds asks passing adventurers to thin the venom web spiders before they make the paths impassable.

faq.q: Who does Watcher Dodds report to?
faq.answer: Watcher Dodds answers to Commander Althea Ebonlocke, who leads the Night Watch from Darkshire's town hall.

angles.text: For Alliance travelers crossing Duskwood, Watcher Dodds's campfire marks one of the few safe places to find friendly support along the dark roads between Darkshire and the western lands.
